_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): row S-05 (chat switch during a persona write). No model call. Chat A is the sandbox chat; chat B is a run-owned checkpoint chat (branch_create, deleted by the sandbox cleanup) that imports the story with setup off, so it auto-locks SO-V2734 Wren and is bound. Back on A (cleared, setup on, story imported, pane pending) a pick of SO-V2734 Tamsin is delayed in-page and B opened inside the delay. loadPersonasModule cannot be delayed from the page (its promise is memoised at startup and the module export is read-only), so the delay sits on the persona switch itself: a one-shot PERSONA_CHANGED listener, which ST's emit awaits inside setUserAvatar between the writer's two owns() checks, opens B with ctx.openGroupChat and arms a recorder on B's chat_metadata.persona. Asserts: no write to B's chat_metadata.persona while B is open (the recorder; lockPersona's only chat-lock effect is that assignment, so this is the observable form of 'setPersonaLockState never called while B is open'), B's lock unchanged in memory and on the server copy, no opener in B; back on A: no message and no lock in memory or on the server, A's server record still pending. Build: dev-diagnostic (dev bundle). Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-switch-during-write.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model dev lane.

requires.why: two run-owned group chats and in-page delays; the persona writes need a lane
